insight: Paris startup, founded 2022; seed-backed by Sequoia, raised a $16M Series A in 2024, and runs EU-hosted with full GDPR data residency.
name: Gladia
tagline: Real-time speech-to-text and audio intelligence through a single API.
description: End-to-end audio infrastructure to record, transcribe, and enrich speech via one API — real-time streaming under ~300ms latency, batch transcription, diarization, translation, and summarization across 100+ languages. Reengineered Whisper for production before shipping its own Solaria models, with EU data residency for compliance-bound teams.

modelSupport.notes: Gladia's own Solaria models, with Whisper-based heritage.

edge: Sub-300ms multilingual real-time transcription with EU data residency — a GDPR-friendly alternative to US-hosted Deepgram and AssemblyAI.

references.title: French AI startup Gladia secures $16M Series A for real-time audio transcription
